  • Question 14 Explain the use of the following commands in book class
  • (a) \openany
  • (b) \openright
  • (c) \backmatter
  • [S] / [CO2]
  • • \openany
  • This command allows chapters to begin on any page (either odd or even). By
  • default, the book class often starts chapters on right-hand (odd-numbered)
  • pages, which may leave blank pages. Using \openany avoids unnecessary
  • blank pages. . . . 3 Marks
  • • \openright
  • This command forces each chapter to start on a right-hand (odd-numbered)
  • page. If the previous chapter ends on an odd page, L ATEX inserts a blank
  • page. . . . 3 Marks
  • • \backmatter
  • This command is used to begin the back matter of the book. Typically used
  • before sections like:
  • (a) Bibliography
  • (b) Index
  • (c) Appendix etc.
  • . . . 3 Marks
